query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Audit analytics and search performance for a website, inspect and modify its source repository, create pull requests with SEO, tracking, caching, routing, and accessibility fixes, and investigate hosting/deployment state.
query_ground_truth.query: fetch website analytics and search performance metrics
query_ground_truth.intent: This query searches for a tool capable of retrieving analytics and search engine performance data for the target website.

MOZ_FETCH_SITE_METRICS.description: Tool to fetch site metrics from Moz including Domain Authority, Page Authority, Spam Score, and link counts. Use when you need SEO metrics for a domain or specific URL. Returns comprehensive link and authority data.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for the JSON-RPC request (min 24 characters). Auto-generated if not provided.

query.description: The domain or URL to fetch metrics for (e.g., 'moz.com', 'example.com').

scope.description: The scope of the query. Use 'domain' for root domain metrics, 'page' for specific URL metrics.

site_query.description: Site query parameters containing the target domain/URL and scope.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_Q.description: Queries Google Search Console for search analytics data including clicks, impressions, CTR, and position metrics. Only returns URLs with at least one impression; missing rows do not confirm non-indexing. Position is an impression-weighted average rank.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

site_url.description: The site's URL, including protocol (e.g., https://www.example.com/) or a domain property (e.g., sc-domain:example.com). URL-prefix properties specify exact protocol and path, while domain properties aggregate data across all subdomains and protocols.

row_limit.description: The maximum number of rows to return. Must be between 1 and 25,000. Note: The API returns top results sorted by clicks (or date when grouping by date). Must be between 1 and 5000. Use start_row to paginate; stop when response rows < row_limit.

start_row.description: The first row to return from the result set. Used for pagination.

dimensions.description: The dimensions to group the data by. Results are sorted by clicks descending, except when grouping by date (sorted by date ascending).

start_date.description: The start date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Data lags 2–3 days (UTC); most recent 1–2 days may be incomplete. Data retention is ~16 months; older ranges return zero rows.

search_type.description: The search type to filter results by.

dimension_filter_groups.description: Optional filters to apply to dimensions. Each filter group contains an array of filters with structure: [{'filters': [{'dimension': 'country', 'operator': 'equals', 'expression': 'USA'}]}]. Operators: equals, notEquals, contains, notContains, includingRegex, excludingRegex. Invalid dimension names, unsupported operators, or mismatched expressions return zero rows without an error — verify each filter before trusting empty results.

MOZ_FETCH_METADATA_INDEX.description: Tool to fetch current index metadata from Moz via JSON-RPC. Returns an index ID that changes when the data in the index is updated. Use when you need to track index updates or verify the current index state.

request_id.description: Optional unique identifier for the JSON-RPC request (min 24 chars). If not provided, a UUID will be generated automatically.
